# harness_platform_iacm_project_drift_config (Resource)

Resource for managing IaCM project-level drift detection configuration. Enables scheduled drift detection across all workspaces in a project for a given provisioner.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier where the project resides.
- `pipeline_id` (String) Pipeline to run for drift detection.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier to configure drift detection for.
- `provisioner_type` (String) Provisioner type to enable drift detection for (terraform, opentofu, terragrunt, awscdk).
- `run_every` (Number) Repeat interval — run drift detection every N units (see run_every_unit).
- `run_every_unit` (String) Unit for the run_every interval. Valid values: seconds (1–59), minutes (1–59), hours (1–24), days (1–31).

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether project-level drift automation is currently enabled.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
